warning_texts: audit/human_decisions.yaml is named by the stage prompt but is not in this step's allowed input paths, so it was not read; the common contract text was read as inlined in the prompt file.

Independent recomputation was done from quarantine/orders.csv (the quarantined projection, comment column removed), deduplicating last row per order_id in file order; taking the last row by updated_at instead changes no used column for any order.

The t quantile for the Student intervals was computed by a Cornish-Fisher expansion because scipy was unavailable; at df above 12000 the error is far below the 0.01 display tolerance and the unrounded bounds agree with the gate to 1e-7.

independent_claim_recalc.json records raw_data/orders.csv as source_paths (claims_recomputed reads raw_latest per check_plan), not clean_data as the stage prompt anticipated; it is rooted neither in analysis/ nor release/, so it does not check itself. recompute_estimate and min_group_size still read

The hypothesis blocks in analysis/answers/R03.json and R04.json sit outside the claim register, so hypotheses_registered, multiplicity, effect_floor and power_declared all saw zero tests; I recomputed both statistics and effect sizes myself (they match), but no machine rule covers them.
No machine rule reads the wording of analysis/answers/*; questions_are_answered checks existence only. This is the unchecked surface where the R03 blocker sits.
No phrase from the quarantined comment column was found in analysis/claim_register.json or analysis/answers/*.

The completion claims' caveats do not say in words that cancelled and pending orders are in the denominator; the recount confirms they are (direct 3322 cancelled and 3457 pending in 24597), so this is recorded as a wording weakness rather than a blocker.
